assets.prompt:

Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY the balcony exterior window glazing. Lock the camera, crop, perspective, architecture, floor, ceiling, wood wall, sconces, curtains, warm daylight, shadows, and every piece of furniture and styling EXACTLY as in the source. In particular retain the identical long wooden bench, cream seat, two cushions at the right, tea tray and teapot on bench, cylindrical bronze side table at left, and tall plant in textured pot at right in precisely the same positions.
Replace the exterior glazing behind the bench with a large uninterrupted full-height clear fixed main pane extending from the existing top frame down to the floor-level bottom frame; remove the visible horizontal mid-height safety rail/window crossbars and the low opaque sill/infill below the existing glazing only. The main pane must have no middle horizontal bar and no internal vertical divider. Keep a narrow framed operable ventilation sash only at the far side of the glazing, with a tiny handle. Preserve the foreground sliding doorway frame and track. The lower continuation of the city/tree view must be consistent with the existing outdoor scene. This is a finished concept photograph, no demolition or construction.
Strict invariants: absolutely no furniture removal or replacement, no layout adjustment, no redesigned styling, no camera movement. Natural detailed wood/linen/stone textures. No people, text, logos, watermark, fisheye or extra rooms.
assets.qa: Accepted: original bench, two cushions, tea tray, bronze side table, planter, curtains, camera and material palette preserved; exterior glass now reaches floor with no center rail/bar and a narrow side ventilation sash. Only glazing changed.
